settings.title: What is Cross-Linked Polyethylene EVA?
settings.text: Cross-Linked Polyethylene EVA (Ethylene Vinyl Acetate) is a high-quality type of foam material, known for its exceptional durability and resilience. This foam is chemically cross-linked, resulting in a closed-cell structure that provides superior performance, enhanced longevity, and excellent shock absorption.

settings.title: Better than standard EVA
settings.text: Outperforms standard EVA in numerous ways with its enhanced shock absorption properties. An ideal choice for combat sports, providing athletes with the safety and comfort they need for intensive workouts and bouts.

settings.subtitle: Cheer with Confidence
settings.title: High-Impact Cheer Mats for Safer Landings
settings.text: Built for the intensity of modern cheerleading, our Roll-Out Cheerleading Mats feature cross-linked polyethylene foam that offers reliable shock absorption for stunts, jumps, and tumbling. The flame-laminated carpet surface is heat-sealed directly to the foam, creating a strong, seamless bond that resists peeling—even after repeated use and roll-ups.

settings.title: Do you offer custom-sized mats?
settings.text: Custom sizes by the foot are also available. If you'd like to order a custom size please call us at1-866-362-2053 or email us at sales@canadamats.ca

settings.title: Do the mats come with straps for storage?
settings.text: Absolutely, each mat roll is supplied with a hook and loop strap to facilitate easy storage. Should you require more, additional storage straps can be conveniently ordered online.

settings.title: What's the weight of a single mat roll?
settings.text: A standard 6’ x 42’ x 1-3/8" carpet roll weighs approximately 107 lbs, while a 2" carpet roll weighs approximately 127 lbs.

settings.title: What are Roll-Out Cheerleading Mats made of?
settings.text: What are Roll-Out Cheerleading Mats made of?

settings.title: Can I use these mats as gymnastics mats or tumbling mats?
settings.text: Yes! Even though they’re called cheerleading mats, they work great as gymnastics mats or tumbling mats. Athletes use them for stunts, flips, acrobatics, dance, and even school gym programs.

settings.title: Are the mats easy to roll out and store?
settings.text: Definitely, the design lets one person roll out a full-size gymnastics mat in just a few minutes. When you’re done, roll it back up for quick storage. That’s why these mats are so popular with traveling teams and multipurpose gyms.

settings.title: Do the mats come in different sizes and thicknesses?
settings.text: Yes. Standard sections are 6' x 42' and you can choose between 1-3/8" or 2" thickness. Need something custom? We can cut mats by the foot, so you get the exact size you need.

settings.title: Can I get custom colours or logos on my mats?
settings.text: You sure can. Our gymnastics mats come in Blue, Red, Black, Gray, and Purple. Plus, we can add your team logo, school name, or sponsor branding for a professional touch.

settings.title: Do I need Velcro fasteners with these mats?
settings.text: If you’re using a single roll, you don’t need Velcro. But if you plan on connecting multiple mats to create a bigger tumbling mat surface, we recommend adding Velcro fasteners (sold separately) to keep everything in place.

settings.title: How durable are these mats?
settings.text: Very durable. The foam and carpet are flame-laminated together for a strong bond, and each mat comes with a 3-year limited warranty. With the right care, they’ll last you for years of training and competitions.

settings.title: Where can I use these mats?
settings.text: Just about anywhere you need a safe, cushioned floor. They’re perfect for cheerleading competitions, gymnastics gyms, tumbling classes, dance performances, school programs, or even at-home practice spaces.
